AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING THE MAYOR AND CLERK OF THE BOARD OF
SUPERVISORS TO EXECUTE A LEASE IN BEHALF OF THE CITY AND COUNTY OF
SAN FRANCISCO WITH THE MILLS ESTATE INCORPORATED, FOR CERTAIN LANDS
SITUATED IN THE COUNTY OF SAN MATEO, STATE OF CALIFORNIA, REQUIRED
FOR AIR PORT PURPOSES.

Pursuant to Resolution No. 26,816 (New Series), the Mayor
and the Clerk of the Board of Supervisors are hereby authorized and
directed to enter into the following lease with the Mills Estate
Incorporated, for lands situated in the County of San Mateo, State of
California, required for air port purposes;

Board of Supervisors Form 20
Buckley & Curtin
RESOLUTION No. 26816
(New Series)
WHEREAS, the United States Government is desirous that
the City and County
of San Francisco acquire an airport,
appearing to be a need and a demand for an airport for the handling
of air mail and other purposes for which airports are used:
AND WHEREAS, there is not a sufficiently large area of
land within
the confines of
the City and County of San Francisco
suitable for airport purposes, and as a proper survey of sites
suitable for a permanent airport is not practical at
this time by
reason of the necessity of observation of climatic conditions of
proposed permanent airport sites for a period of at least one year,
and it is estimated that it will take approximately two years to
put in condition for the use of an airport any of the proposed
permanent sites,
and there has been provision made in the budget
for the present
fiscal year for the acquisition of an airport,
and the people having at the recent election made known their
desire
to acquire an airport, and it further appearing that the hereinafter
described parcel of land, situate in the County of San Mateo,
of California, may be put in condition for the uses of a temporary
airport and in a shorter space of time than any other available site;
THEREFORE, BE IT RESOIED, that the Committee on
Airports negotiate with the owners of the
following described property
situate in San Mateo County, California, and described as follows:
Sections 34 and 35 of township 3 south range
and section 2 of township 4 south
awest 3 west M.D.Bod Ma by the 113218 Estate,
which property is owned
Incorporated,
for the purpose of leasing the said property for a temporary airport
site and to lease the said property for a period
of three (3) years
at a rental not to exceed Ten ($10.00) Dollars per acre per year, and
the additional sum of Twenty-five
($25.00) Dollars per acre at the
termination of the lease to allow the lessor to recondition the land
used
as a
temporary airport and providing for such other terms as are
equitable to the owners of the land and the City and County of Sar
Francisco, and that the City Attorney prepare such a lease and submit
the same for approval of this Board.
Adopted-Board of Supervisors, San Francisco,.
